trash.title: Trash
trash.emptyHint: Files moved to a .hoard-trash folder, and the originals of compressed videos, show here until the trash is emptied.
trash.otherHint: Hoard restores and empties these on the share; the server only lists them.

compress.title: Compress videos
compress.heading: Compress {{name}}

target.nas: Library videos: the server replaces the files in the library.
target.backup: Backups no longer on a phone are compressed on the server.
target.phone: Phone videos replace that phone's files: start them from Hoard on the phone.

profile.label: Look
profile.sameDesc: HEVC cq 28: the approved look, about a fifth of the size.
profile.smallerDesc: HEVC cq 30: about 1 VMAF point less for another 15–25 % of size.
profile.av1Desc: AV1 cq 34: 14–22 % smaller than HEVC; plays only where AV1 decodes in hardware.

quality.label: Quality
quality.floorDesc: cq 28, encoded again at a lower q only when VMAF is under 93.
quality.fixedDesc: One encode at the profile's q, no re-encode.
quality.targetDesc: Searches the q that reaches the VMAF below (2–3 encodes per video).

estimate.title: Estimate
estimate.failed: The estimate could not be made. Try again.
estimate.nothing: Nothing to compress here: every video is skipped.
estimate.pending_one: {{count}} video is still being read; the job estimates it again.
estimate.pending_other: {{count}} videos are still being read; the job estimates them again.
estimate.leftOut_one: {{count}} video left out (not on the library or a phone backup the server compresses).
estimate.leftOut_other: {{count}} videos left out (not on the library or a phone backup the server compresses).

warnings.hdr10plus: HDR10+ dynamic metadata cannot be kept: the video stays HDR10.
warnings.pcm_audio: PCM audio is encoded to AAC 256k.
warnings.av1_playback: AV1 plays only on devices that decode it in hardware.
warnings.per_frame_metadata: Per-frame camera data is saved on the server.

trash.note_one: Originals go to the trash: restore them there until it is emptied ({{count}} day).
trash.note_other: Originals go to the trash: restore them there until it is emptied ({{count}} days).
trash.label: Original of a compressed video
trash.emptyNowBody: {{name}}: the original is deleted for good and its space is saved. The compressed video stays.
trash.purgeBody_one: {{count}} original ({{size}}) is deleted for good by the server. The compressed video stays.
trash.purgeBody_other: {{count}} originals ({{size}}) are deleted for good by the server. The compressed videos stay.

refusal.no_write_mount: the server cannot write the library now
refusal.busy: a compression is working on it
refusal.state: it cannot be changed in its state
refusal.live_missing: the video is no longer where it was

trash.alsoKept_one: {{count}} original's bytes stay: also kept by a backup or Reveal.
trash.alsoKept_other: {{count}} originals' bytes stay: also kept by a backup or Reveal.
trash.held: Held by a compression in progress
trash.heldSection: Held by a compression in progress
trash.heldNote: A compression is still moving these files; nothing empties them until it finishes.
trash.busy: A compression is working on it.

auto.existing_one: Also compress the {{count}} video already there
auto.existing_other: Also compress the {{count}} videos already there
auto.exists: This folder is compressed automatically already.

jobs.title: In progress
jobs.cancelBody: Videos not compressed yet stay as they are. Videos already compressed stay compressed: restore them from the trash.

item.title: Compressed
item.logFailed: The log could not be loaded.
item.metaSaved: Per-frame camera data saved on the server

skip.older_compression_other: already compressed by an older tool
skip.dolby_vision_one: in Dolby Vision (kept as it is)
skip.dolby_vision_other: in Dolby Vision (kept as they are)

skip.not_writable_other: in folders the server cannot write

skip.not_in_target_other: not on the library or a backup

reason.trash_failed: the original could not be moved to the trash

unavailable.no_gpu: This server cannot compress videos: no working NVIDIA encoder.
unavailable.no_tools: This server cannot compress videos: tools are missing.

unavailable.write_mount_mismatch: Library videos cannot be replaced: the write mount is not the library's folder.

unavailable.no_backup_root: Choose a backup folder on the setup page first.
unavailable.other: This server cannot compress these videos now.

status.stalled_other: {{count}} compressions wait: see the setup page's Compression tab.
